method: Primary agent manual source review of every current-material claim eligible for the visible reading section, including expanded claims. Separate independent Sol review receives only UI.

claims.claim: README 声明 ProjectFlow 用于理解项目现状、阅读真实变化并维护长期项目记忆。
claims.finding: Purpose is explicitly a README declaration, not verified runtime behavior.

claims.claim: 仓库包含 quality-gates.yml、后端测试文件和 docker-compose.yml；backend/pom.xml 还配置 postgres-it profile 及 Maven Failsafe 的 integration-test 和 verify goal，前端 package lock 声明 @playwright/test。
claims.finding: Profile, Failsafe goals, Playwright dependency and files exist. No passing execution is inferred.

claims.claim: 当前 Git worktree 为 CLEAN，记录 332 个提交且无 Tag；历史覆盖报告尚无提交与 ProjectFact 关联。
claims.inspectedSource: git status --porcelain; git rev-list --count HEAD; git tag; persisted history coverage
claims.finding: Frozen clone is clean, 332 commits and no tags. Zero Fact coverage is a property of this isolated intake, not of the source project.

claims.claim: 扫描统计为 1321 个文件、712 个源码文件、约 130442 LOC，仓库分类为 LARGE。
claims.finding: Counts are reported scan estimates within intake coverage; this audit does not independently recalculate LOC.

claims.claim: README 将项目声明为按身份、角色和权限工作的企业 Agent Workspace。
claims.finding: Enterprise Agent Workspace identity is a source declaration.

claims.claim: README 声明普通沟通和通知不调用模型，仅在用户明确查询或分析时创建 AgentRun。
claims.finding: Ordinary communication and notification model-use behavior remains a README declaration.

claims.claim: docker-compose.yml 样本配置 PostgreSQL 17-alpine，并将数据库端口绑定到本机回环地址。
claims.finding: PostgreSQL 17-alpine and loopback binding are configuration observations, not a running database assertion.

claims.claim: README 标题、backend/pyproject.toml 和 frontend/package-lock.json 根包均记录版本 2.2.0。
claims.finding: All three version fields are 2.2.0. No release or deployment is inferred.

claims.claim: WORKTREE_STATUS 在工具读取时未发现 staged、unstaged 或 untracked 路径。
claims.finding: Frozen clone remains clean; reading-time wording does not assert subsequent state.

claims.claim: 扫描记录 287 个文件，其中 163 个为源码文件，估算约 21757 行代码，规模分类为 MEDIUM。
claims.finding: Counts remain intake estimates, not product outcome or maturity.

claims.claim: 测试、构建、质量或部署信号来自真实文件盘点。
claims.inspectedSource: persisted intake inventory and source map
claims.finding: Only presence of engineering files is asserted, not execution success.

limitations: No functional runtime validation of the dogfood source repositories is claimed.
Inventory estimates are checked against persisted intake, not independently recomputed.
Final UI correspondence is covered separately by the final visual manifest.
